biomarkers.name: WHO histologic type (A, AB, B1, B2, B3)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Primary prognostic classification; B3 more aggressive; type A most indolent

biomarkers.name: TdT, CD5 (thymic epithelial cells)
biomarkers.prevalence: Thymoma epithelial cells are typically CD5 negative; TdT highlights non-neoplastic immature thymocytes rather than neoplastic epithelial cells
biomarkers.clinical_use: Helps distinguish thymoma from thymic carcinoma, in which epithelial cells more often express CD5; TdT supports the presence of accompanying immature thymocytes

biomarkers.name: GTF2I mutation
biomarkers.prevalence: ~40% overall; enriched in type A and AB thymoma
biomarkers.clinical_use: Characteristic molecular alteration of thymoma; associates with more indolent behaviour

biomarkers.name: Anti-AChR antibodies (myasthenia gravis)
biomarkers.prevalence: ~30-50% of thymoma patients have myasthenia gravis; anti-AChR antibodies are common in thymoma-associated MG

biomarkers.name: PD-L1
biomarkers.clinical_use: Predictive role in thymoma is not established; immune checkpoint inhibitors have shown activity in thymic epithelial tumors but thymoma carries a high risk of severe immune-related adverse events including myocarditis, myositis, and hepatitis

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Epithelial neoplasm of thymic epithelial cells with variable immature T-cell infiltrate
histomorphological_subtype.grading: WHO A/AB/B1/B2/B3 classification prognostic; Masaoka-Koga staging

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Rich in T-lymphoblasts (physiologic thymic function) — 'inflamed' but with distinct biology from lymphocytic infiltrate in carcinomas
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Fibrous septa; medullary and cortical patterns depending on WHO type

cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Endoderm (thymic epithelium from third pharyngeal pouch) with mesenchymal (neural crest) capsular contribution
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Retains thymic epithelial differentiation — WHO subtypes A, AB, B1, B2, B3 reflect gradient from bland spindle cells to cortical-like → medullary-like architecture
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Retention of thymic epithelial function drives inappropriate T-cell selection → paraneoplastic autoimmunity (myasthenia gravis, PRCA)
